Sandbox_WaterWellCapacity_tooltip: Set the maximum water storage capacity for More Builds wells. Default: 1200
Sandbox_WaterPumpCapacity_tooltip: Set the maximum water storage capacity for More Builds water pumps. Default: 100
Sandbox_InitialWaterPercent_tooltip: Set the percentage of capacity filled when a More Builds water source is constructed. Default: 25
Sandbox_AutomaticWaterRefillMultiplier_t: Multiply the hourly automatic refill of More Builds water sources. Set to 0 to disable automatic refilling. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_MinimumBuildRole_tooltip: Enter the exact name of the lowest role allowed to build. Roles at or above it in the server role order can build. Default: user. Use banned to allow every role that can join the server.
Sandbox_EnablePopularBuildings_tooltip: In multiplayer, track decaying construction popularity scores on the server and show the Popular Buildings category.
Sandbox_PopularBuildingsMinimumScore_too: Set the minimum popularity score required for a building to appear. Each completed construction adds 1 point. Default: 5
Sandbox_PopularBuildingsMaximumVisible_t: Set the maximum number of buildings shown in the Popular Buildings category. Default: 24
Sandbox_PopularityHalfLifeDays_tooltip: Set the number of in-game days after which all popularity scores are halved. Set to 0 to keep permanent cumulative scores. Default: 7
